official.status_note: PSC states: 'Applications for PSC Master's Scholarships for 2027 are now open and will close on 15 March 2027.'
official.tuition_coverage_note: Tuition fees and other approved charges. For overseas degrees, return airfare will be provided.
benefits: Tuition fees and other approved charges
A series of sponsored development programmes, including student exchange and summer opportunities
Emplacement on the Public Service Leadership Programme on graduation
eligibility: Demonstrate Strong Leadership Qualities and Potential
Present themselves as well-rounded individuals, possessing good academic and non-academic records

Apply during the final year of undergraduate studies, or as a fresh graduate with no more than 3 years of working experience (including part-time or contract work) in the private or non-government sector only
Be prepared to start the Master's programme in the immediate academic year following the offer of the scholarship
GCE A-levels; or International Baccalaureate; or NUS High School Diploma; or Polytechnic Diploma; or other high school diploma or equivalent; and university results
requirements: Choose between the PSC Master's Scholarship or the PSC Master's Scholarship (Sustainability)
Sustainability applicants should be intending to read a Master's in a field related to sustainability and circularity
Courses must be relevant to the Public Service, subject to PSC's approval
Complete the online application with the necessary supporting documents, an essay, and a video interview
A valid Singpass account is required to access and submit the scholarship application form
documents: Secondary 4 / Year 4 Year End School Academic Reports (including results and teachers' comments)
Secondary 4 / Year 4 Co-curricular Activities (CCA) and Community Involvement Programme (CIP) Records

Certificates of Academic Qualification Obtained (e.g. GCE O-level, GCE A-level, International Baccalaureate Diploma, NUS High School Diploma, Polytechnic Diploma, other high school diploma or equivalent)
University Academic Transcripts and University CCA Records
Employment Testimonials (if applicable), NS Certificate of Service and Testimonial (if applicable), Public Service Internship Testimonials (if applicable)
selection_criteria: Performance in the psychometric assessments, game-based assessments and psychological interview is taken into consideration when deciding on further shortlisting
Only candidates who complete all assessments will undergo a panel interview with the Public Service Commission Scholarships Selection Board (PSSB)
Shortlisted candidates are informed of the next assessment rounds and steps to be taken
coverage: Tuition fees and other approved charges
Sponsored development programmes including student exchange and summer opportunities
Gap Year Programme and Public Service Leadership Programme placements
application_method: Log in to the PSC Gateway Portal via Singpass
Complete the online application form (Personal & Family Details, Education History, Achievements, Career and Course Preferences, University Applications, Other Details, Declaration)
Submit the required essay alongside the application form
Upload and submit all supporting documents; the application is only complete when form, essay and documents are all submitted
Receive the video interview link within 7 days of successful submission and complete the video interview
If shortlisted, attend psychometric assessments, game-based assessments and a psychological interview, then a panel interview with the PSSB
official.application_route: Apply online through the PSC Gateway Portal with Singpass before 15 March 2027, completing form, essay, document uploads and a video interview.
official.international_eligibility: No. The published criterion is that applicants must be Singapore Citizens.
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Courses must be relevant to the Public Service and approved by PSC; MBA programmes are not allowed; the Sustainability variant requires a Master's in a field related to sustainability and circularity.
official.duration: Maximum 2 years of study in any country, followed by a 3-year bond
official.description: PSC describes the PSC Master's Scholarships as the premier government merit scholarship for those wishing to pursue a Master's degree and a career in Public Administration in the Singapore Public Service, across the wide spectrum of public governance work from policy formulation to implementation.
official.program_type: Government postgraduate scholarship for Public Administration and Sustainability in the Singapore Public Service

verification.notes: Read the PSC Master's Scholarships page and the PSC Master's apply page on psc.gov.sg; PSC publishes the award components (tuition and approved charges, return airfare for overseas degrees, allowances, development programmes) but no monetary figure, so no amount is recorded. Deadline, eligibility, study duration and bond read directly from the official pages.

applicant_utility.summary: The Master's route is narrow by design: it is for Citizen final-year undergraduates or fresh graduates whose experience sits entirely in the private or non-government sector, and it must lead to a Master's that PSC approves, with MBAs explicitly ruled out. The Sustainability variant is the same package with a sustainability-and-circularity first posting, so the choice you make at application shapes where you land afterwards. Study is capped at two years in any country and carries a three-year bond.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Final-year Singapore Citizen undergraduates or fresh graduates with under three years of private or non-government sector experience who want a Public Service leadership career rather than a technical or MBA track.
application_readiness_checklist: Check your work history against the 'private or non-government sector only' rule; three years including part-time and contract work is the ceiling.
Pick between the standard and Sustainability variants before you start, and make sure your intended Master's subject lines up with that choice.
Verify your intended programme is not an MBA and is one PSC can approve as relevant to the Public Service.
Confirm you can matriculate in the academic year immediately after the offer, since that is a stated condition.
Gather the same Secondary 4 and pre-tertiary document set as the undergraduate PSC route, plus university transcripts and university CCA records.
common_rejection_risks: Holding more than three years of qualifying experience, or having spent it in the public sector.
Proposing an MBA or a course PSC judges outside the Public Service relevance test.
Being unable to start in the immediate next academic year, which is an explicit condition.
Applying for the Sustainability variant without a genuine sustainability-and-circularity subject.
Leaving the essay or one document set unsubmitted, which stops the application being counted as complete.
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: No allowance amount is published, so living costs beyond the stated maintenance allowance cannot be sized from the official page; anything outside the approved course is self-funded.
document_audit: The document set blends school-level records (Secondary 4 / Year 4 reports, CCA and CIP records) with university transcripts and university CCA records, so pre-university paper has to be dug out years later.
Employment testimonials are required if applicable, and Public Service internship testimonials are listed for those who have done them.
The NS Certificate of Service and Testimonial applies to those who have served National Service and takes time to obtain.
Preliminary examination results are explicitly not required.
alerts: The 3-year bond starts on graduation and holders are emplaced on the Public Service Leadership Programme, so the commitment is a leadership career rather than a single job.
Outcomes are not all issued until June, and assessments and interviews run from August to June, so plan around a long resolution window.
The Gap Year Programme is available after studies and National Service but before joining the Service, which can shift your start date by six to twelve months.
Sustainability variant holders take a first posting in a sustainability and circularity role, which narrows later mobility at the outset.
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Singpass login, then form plus essay plus uploads, then a video interview link within 7 days, then assessments and a PSSB panel interview, with an outcome by June.
